hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\"" | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *live-coding.md*) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Les interactions Bash avec live-coding.md sont bloquées\"}}";; esac; }

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; output=$(./mvnw -o test 2>&1); line=$(echo "$output" | grep -E "Tests run: [0-9]+, Failures: [0-9]+, Errors: [0-9]+, Skipped: [0-9]+$" | tail -1); if [ -z "$line" ]; then msg="Tests: build failed to run"; else run=$(echo "$line" | grep -oE "Tests run: [0-9]+" | grep -oE "[0-9]+"); fail=$(echo "$line" | grep -oE "Failures: [0-9]+" | grep -oE "[0-9]+"); err=$(echo "$line" | grep -oE "Errors: [0-9]+" | grep -oE "[0-9]+"); passed=$((run - fail - err)); if [ "$fail" -eq 0 ] && [ "$err" -eq 0 ]; then msg="$passed/$run tests passed"; else msg="$passed/$run tests passed ($((fail+err)) failed)"; fi; fi; printf '{"systemMessage": "%s"}' "$msg"
